label: Prop Strike (gag card)
description: The gag prop: a white card carrying a word or logo gets a hand-drawn X struck through it (the 'we killed ___' joke). Card enters with the house line-rise; the X draws in as two fast strokes and the card takes a little hit. One joke per scene -- pair it with a kinetic-text setup line beside it.

text.label: The word on the card (styled like a muted logotype)

ink.label: Stroke color of the X (default near-black #17171c)

text_color.label: Card text color (default muted logotype grey #a9adb6)

hold.label: Seconds after the strike before the card fades (0/omit = stays)
